questions.question: The attested context and node metadata are new fields on the statement response. Making them REQUIRED breaks existing typed fixtures in the backend export test and the frontend statement/drill/report tests — all type-checked, all outside this task's scope. How should the contract declare them?
options: Optional in the type, always populated, asserted by a leaf (Recommended)
Required, and fix every fixture now
questions.chosen: Optional in the type, always populated, asserted by a leaf (Recommended)
